payload.summary: The registry asks for a FY2024 group-consolidated ESRS E1 Scope 2 CO₂e disclosure for the the company EMEA portfolio, built from divisionally-owned, divisionally-attested sub-totals, with a consolidated total, an unattested-coverage flag, and a FY2027 readiness assessment. Directive (EU) 2022/2464 (CSRD) grounds the core concepts: consolidated group sustainability reporting by a parent of a large group (Art 29a), the obligation to disclose Scope 1/2/(3) GHG emissions under the environmental reporting standards (Art 29b(2)(a)(i), recital 47), the duty to surface significant differences at subsidiary level (Art 29a(4)), the (limited) assurance/attestation regime (recital 60, Art 34(1)(aa)), and the phased application timeline (Art 5). This supports fields for division, site, reporting year, Scope 2 emissions, calculation method/provenance, and attestation status. The specific ESRS E1-4 metric structure (location- vs market-based Scope 2), the EMEA/division organisational model, and an explicit FY2027 milestone are not contained in this directive and are noted as missing context.

Article 5 continuation of phased application dates for issuers and further undertaking categories.

possible_fields.reason: The registry consolidates separately-owned divisional sub-totals; the directive requires group reporting that provides adequate understanding of sub-unit differences, so the division grain is needed to attribute each sub-total and its provenance.

possible_fields.name: site_identifier
possible_fields.description: Identifier of the EMEA operational site whose emissions roll up into a division's Scope 2 sub-total.
possible_fields.reason: Scope 2 emissions must be attributed to the undertaking's own operations across its sites; site-level identity supports aggregation into divisional and consolidated portfolio totals.

possible_fields.name: reporting_year
possible_fields.description: The financial/reporting year of the disclosure (FY2024) and the basis for FY2027 readiness assessment.
possible_fields.reason: The consolidated Scope 2 disclosure covers a specific reporting period and the phased application dates make the reporting year essential for both the FY2024 report and the FY2027 readiness assessment.

possible_fields.name: scope2_ghg_emissions
possible_fields.description: The Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions expressed in CO₂-equivalent for a site/division/group.
possible_fields.reason: This is the central numeric value the registry needs: divisionally-owned Scope 2 sub-totals and the consolidated portfolio total, directly required by the GHG emission disclosure standards.
possible_fields.expected_grain: per division per year (aggregable to group)

possible_fields.name: emission_calculation_method
possible_fields.description: The methodology/standard used to compute the Scope 2 figure (method provenance), e.g., calculation approach and emission-factor basis.
possible_fields.reason: The registry requires per-division method provenance; the directive mandates reporting in accordance with the sustainability reporting standards, making the disclosed method an operational attribute of each sub-total.

possible_fields.name: attestation_status
possible_fields.description: The divisional attestation/sign-off status of a Scope 2 sub-total (attested by owning division or not attested).
possible_fields.reason: The registry preserves each division's attestation and flags unattested sub-totals; the directive's assurance regime and subsidiary-level accountability ground the need for an attestation status attribute per sub-total.

possible_fields.name: site_region
possible_fields.description: The geographic region classification of a site (e.g., EMEA) used to scope the portfolio.
possible_fields.reason: The site filter restricts to EMEA; the standards call for geographical/contextual information, so a region attribute supports scoping the consolidated portfolio.

possible_fields.name: purchased_energy_consumption
possible_fields.description: Purchased electricity/heat/steam/cooling consumption underlying the Scope 2 calculation.
possible_fields.reason: Scope 2 emissions derive from purchased energy; energy consumption data supports and verifies the reported Scope 2 figures, and energy aspects are explicitly to be considered in the standards.

handoff_data_request.intent: Produce a CSRD-compliant ESRS E1 Scope 2 CO₂ group disclosure for the the company EMEA portfolio via group-consolidated divisional inventories. Each in-scope business-unit division (DI, Business Unit 1, SI, Business Unit 2, Business Unit 3, Business Unit 4) independently compiles, owns, and attests its own divisional Scope 2 CO₂e sub-total covering its EMEA sites; no division can produce or sign off another division's figure. The group then consolidates the separately-owned, separately-signed sub-results into one ESRS E1 portfolio total, preserving each division's provenance chain and attestation. Any divisional sub-total not attested by its owning division must be flagged as unattested in the consolidated report. The consolidated result must be suitable for inclusion in the the company ESRS E1 Climate Change disclosure and carry a FY2027 mandatory-reporting readiness assessment (CSRD Art. 8 + ESRS E1-4 cross-boundary obligations).

payload.rationale: CP1's assurance_artifact is distributed_signoff — the strongest and most decisive signal — and it points directly at Coalition. bullets.point: ESRS E1's Scope 2 disclosure is built to require both a location-based and a market-based figure, in line with the GHG Protocol Corporate Standard and Scope 2 Guidance, precisely because a single-method choice would undermine comparability.
